Between 20 years to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026)
Office of District Ayurvedic and Unani Officer, Room No. 302-303, Third Floor, District Administrative Complex, Sangrur

content_sections.heading: District AYUSH Society Sangrur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download District AYUSH Society Sangrur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10+2 Pass from a recognized Educational Board; Punjabi pass up to Matric Standard; Certificate/ Diploma/ Degree in Yoga from a recognized Institute/ Body or minimum 5 Years Experience certificate from a Yoga Institute; Should be medically fit as per the Medical certificates issued by the concerned Civil Surgeon Experience: Minimum 5 Years Experience certificate from a Yoga Institute (as an alternative to a Certificate/ Diploma/ Degree in Yoga) Age limit: Between 20 years to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Punjabi pass up to Matric Standard Should be medically fit as per the Medical certificates issued by the concerned Civil Surgeon Instructor conducts only the YOGA/ IEC Session in the morning Desirable: Preference will be given to the candidates residing in the same village where AYUSH HWCs is located

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Part-time engagement linked to performance parameters based on YOGA/ IEC session hours conducted No request for transfer to any other AYUSH HWC or healthcare facility will be entertained Engagement gives no claim of regularization, fixed remuneration, allowances and leaves DAUO shall remove the instructor if no session is held for 3 consecutive working days Removal if participants per session are less than 10 for 3 consecutive days, or for indiscipline or insubordination No honorarium during training or for a part session

rows.event: Last Date of Submission of Applications (till 5:00 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will District AYUSH Society Sangrur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit determined by the interview committee after interview, as per the selection criteria Marks for 10+2 percentage (pro-rata out of 10), Yoga certificate/diploma/degree (10/15/20), Yoga experience (max 5), age (max 5) and interview (5) Percentage of marks in 10+2 calculated pro-rata out of 10 marks Yoga Certificate 10 marks, Diploma 15 marks, Degree 20 marks, irrespective of marks obtained Yoga experience from a Yoga institute: 1 mark per completed year, maximum 5 marks; no marks for part-year Age marks: 20-25 years 3, 26-35 years 5, 36-45 years 4 Interview: 5 marks Committee: Deputy Commissioner or representative, DAUO, District Homeopathy Officer, one Ayurvedic Medical Officer trained in Yoga Protocol

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Eligibility documents Experience Certificate Educational Qualification certificate Punjabi pass certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District AYUSH Society Sangrur Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Use the application proforma printed with the notice; proforma and instructions are also on Sangrur.nic.in. Attach eligibility documents: Experience Certificate, Educational Qualification and Punjabi pass certificate. Send the application by post or deliver it by hand to the office of the District Ayurvedic and Unani Officer, Room No. 302-303, Third Floor, District Administrative Complex, Sangrur. Applications must be submitted by 13-11-2026 till 5:00 PM. Original certificates must be produced at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Office can be contacted on any working day from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Selected instructors who are 10+2 pass without Yoga certificate/ Diploma/ Degree will undergo institutional training; no honorarium during training A waiting list will be kept; a vacant spot may be offered to the next candidate as per merit Minimum 10 participants per session needed to be eligible for honorarium Original certificates must be produced at the interview

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District AYUSH Society Sangrur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District AYUSH Society Sangrur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Male Yoga Instructor (Part Time).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District AYUSH Society Sangrur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form on page 5 of this notice; proforma also on Sangrur.nic.in) and send it to Office of District Ayurvedic and Unani Officer, Room No. 302-303, Third Floor, District Administrative Complex, Sangrur, by by post or by hand, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 20 years to 45 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium Rs 250 per session; maximum 32 sessions per month for a Male Instructor.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10+2 Pass from a recognized Educational Board; Punjabi pass up to Matric Standard; Certificate/ Diploma/ Degree in Yoga from a recognized Institute/ Body or minimum 5 Years Experience certificate from a Yoga Institute.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Punjabi pass up to Matric Standard. Should be medically fit as per the Medical certificates issued by the concerned Civil Surgeon. Instructor conducts only the YOGA/ IEC Session in the morning.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit determined by the interview committee after interview, as per the selection criteria. Marks for 10+2 percentage (pro-rata out of 10), Yoga certificate/diploma/degree (10/15/20), Yoga experience (max 5), age (max 5) and interview (5). Percentage of marks in 10+2 calculated pro-rata out of 10 marks. Yoga Certificate 10 marks, Diploma 15 marks, Degree 20 marks, irrespective of marks obtained.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Part-time engagement linked to performance parameters based on YOGA/ IEC session hours conducted. No request for transfer to any other AYUSH HWC or healthcare facility will be entertained. Engagement gives no claim of regularization, fixed remuneration, allowances and leaves.
